_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Producibility Analysis Report
summary: The Producibility Analysis Report evaluates a manufacturer's methods of investigation and assessment to determine effective manufacturing methods and describe compatible design characteristics and material selections.
use_relationship:
Producibility analysis as a requirement permits the evaluation of the manufacturer's methods of conducting investigations and assessments to determine the most effective manufacturing methods of an end product within cost and associated schedule. The Producibility Analysis Report shall describe design characteristics and material selections which are compatible with economic production methods to include supply inventory availability and stability for longer term end product sustainment.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
b. This DID is applicable during Producibility Engineering and Planning (PEP) and engineering in support of new items planned to enter production.
c. This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-80797.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The manufacturer shall ensure that the design will have, consistent with the quality and design requirements, the specific characteristics for producibility and sustainment. The Producibility Analysis Report shall contain the following:

children.title: Procedures, drivers and criteria for selecting candidate items for producibility analysis
Individual trade-off studies, when applicable, on:
Standardization of design, materials and components
Critical Material(s) and associated supply inventory availability and stability for product sustainment
Risk Mitigation with Diminishing Manufacturing Sources and Materials Sources (DMSMS) and Obsolescence
Safety and risk mitigation plans for manufacturing risks
Any other factors impacting program objectives
Recommendation for producibility enhancements to include:
Redesign of special purpose tooling and equipment
Safety and ergonomics for effective design and operation
Mitigate Risk with DMSMS and Obsolescence
Production Configuration Baseline & Changes:
children.content: Inspection of marked-up or redrawn drawings and associated proposed or approved changes in accordance with the approved configuration baseline and any other related technical documents to indicate recommended and/or approved changes to the item or end product.
